import Base
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-pair-result.bend as Pair
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-pair-classify.bend as Classify
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-address-lookup.bend as Lookup
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-address-answer.bend as Answer
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-search-run.bend as Run
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-search-response.bend as Response
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-name.bend as Name
import ../packages/runtime/src/url-ipv4.bend as IPv4
import ../packages/runtime/src/url-ipv6.bend as IPv6
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-transport.bend as Transport
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-udp-servers.bend as UDP
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-udp-policy.bend as Policy
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-udp-query.bend as Datagram
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-udp-attempt-scope.bend as Scope
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-message.bend as Message
import ../packages/runtime/src/socket-endpoint.bend as Endpoint
import ../packages/runtime/src/abort.bend as Abort
import ../packages/runtime/src/deadline.bend as Deadline
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-tcp-query.bend as TCP
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-tcp-session.bend as Session
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-tcp-servers.bend as Servers
import ../packages/runtime/src/abortable-connect.bend as Connect
import ../packages/runtime/src/abortable-datagram.bend as SocketIO
import ../packages/runtime/src/socket-interrupt.bend as Interrupt
import ../packages/runtime/src/dns-id.bend as Id
import ../packages/runtime/test/utf8-runner.bend as Scalar

def udp(failure: UDP.Failure<String>, end: Scope.End<String>) -> Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>:
  Fail{Lookup.Transport{Transport.Datagram{UDP.Failed{UDP.Report{Endpoint.V4{IPv4.Address{2130706433}, 53}, failure, end}}}}}

def flags(reason: Policy.Rejection) -> U32:
  match reason:
    case Policy.ServerFailure{}: 33154
    case Policy.NotImplemented{}: 33156
    case Policy.Refused{}: 33157
    case Policy.UnhelpfulEmpty{}: 32768

def rejected(+reason: Policy.Rejection, end: Scope.End<String>) -> Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>:
  udp(UDP.Rejected{Message.Header{42, flags(reason), 1, 0, 0, 0}, reason}, end)

def input(token: String) -> Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>:
  match token:
    case "a4": Done{Answer.Selection{Name.Name{(97 <> Nil{}) <> Nil{}}, Answer.V4{IPv4.Address{16909060}, 61} <> Nil{}}}
    case "a6": Done{Answer.Selection{Name.Name{(98 <> Nil{}) <> Nil{}}, Answer.V6{IPv6.Address{0, 0, 0, 1}, 73} <> Nil{}}}
    case "empty": Done{Answer.Selection{Name.Name{Nil{}}, Nil{}}}
    case "u2": rejected(Policy.ServerFailure{}, Scope.Active{})
    case "u4": rejected(Policy.NotImplemented{}, Scope.Active{})
    case "u5": rejected(Policy.Refused{}, Scope.Active{})
    case "uempty": rejected(Policy.UnhelpfulEmpty{}, Scope.Active{})
    case "uexpired2": rejected(Policy.ServerFailure{}, Scope.AttemptExpired{})
    case "uparent": rejected(Policy.ServerFailure{}, Scope.ParentAborted{Abort.Supplied{Deadline.ParentAbort{Abort.Supplied{"parent marker"}}}})
    case "udefault": rejected(Policy.Refused{}, Scope.UnexpectedDefaultAbort{})
    case "utimeout": udp(UDP.Exchange{Datagram.Aborted{Abort.Supplied{Deadline.Expired{}}}}, Scope.AttemptExpired{})
    case "uerrno111": udp(UDP.Exchange{Datagram.Transport{SocketIO.SocketError{111, "udp refused marker"}}}, Scope.Active{})
    case "uerrno110": udp(UDP.Exchange{Datagram.Transport{SocketIO.SocketError{110, "udp timeout marker"}}}, Scope.Active{})
    case "teof": Fail{Lookup.Transport{Transport.Stream{Servers.Failed{TCP.Completed{Fail{TCP.Terminated{Session.EndOfStream{}}}, Done{Unit{}}}}}}}
    case "terrno111": Fail{Lookup.Exchange{TCP.Connection{Connect.SocketError{111, "tcp refused marker"}}}}
    case "terrno110": Fail{Lookup.Exchange{TCP.Connection{Connect.SocketError{110, "tcp timeout marker"}}}}
    case "tcleanup": Fail{Lookup.Transport{Transport.Stream{Servers.Failed{TCP.Completed{Fail{TCP.Terminated{Session.EndOfStream{}}}, Fail{Interrupt.Error{9, "cleanup marker"}}}}}}}
    case "abort": Fail{Lookup.Aborted{Abort.Supplied{Deadline.ParentAbort{Abort.Supplied{"abort marker"}}}}}
    case "entropy": Fail{Lookup.Identifier{Id.SourceFailure{87, "entropy marker"}}}
    case "invalid": Fail{Lookup.Selection{Answer.AliasLoop{}}}
    case "unsupported": Fail{Lookup.UnsupportedType{}}
    case "noservers": Fail{Lookup.NoServers{}}
    case SCon{'c', code}: Fail{Lookup.Selection{Answer.ResponseCode{Scalar.decimal(code, 0)}}}
    case _: Fail{Lookup.InvalidReadSize{}}

def cause(value: Response.Cause) -> String:
  match value:
    case Response.EmptyAnswer{}: "empty"
    case Response.Missing{}: "missing"
    case Response.ServerFailure{}: "server"
    case Response.TemporaryFailure{}: "temporary"
    case Response.Unrecoverable{}: "unrecoverable"
    case Response.ConnectionRefused{}: "refused"

def disposition(value: Pair.Disposition) -> String:
  match value:
    case Pair.Answer{}: "answer"
    case Pair.Terminal{}: "terminal"
    case Pair.Reply{code}: "reply:" ++ U32.show(code)
    case Pair.Unavailable{why}: "unavailable:" ++ cause(why)

def reports(value: Pair.Reports<Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>>) -> String:
  match value:
    case Pair.Reports{Pair.Classified{_, a}, Pair.Classified{_, b}}: disposition(a) ++ "/" ++ disposition(b)

def outcome(value: Run.Outcome<Pair.Reports<Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>>, Pair.Reports<Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>>>) -> String:
  match value:
    case Run.Answer{values}: "answer:" ++ reports(values)
    case Run.Halt{values}: "halt:" ++ reports(values)
    case Run.Failed{why}: "failed:" ++ cause(why)

def args(values: List<String>) -> IO(Unit):
  match values:
    case Nil{}: IO.pure(Unit, Unit{})
    case first <> left <> right <> rest:
      do IO<Unit>:
        +a : Pair.Classified<Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>> <- Classify.classify(~String, input(left))
        +b : Pair.Classified<Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>> <- Classify.classify(~String, input(right))
        IO.print(reports(Pair.Reports{a, b}) ++ "=" ++ outcome(Pair.merge(Result<&2, &2, Lookup.Error<String>, Answer.Selection>, Bool.pick(Pair.Priority, String.eq(first, "4"), Pair.IPv4First{}, Pair.IPv6First{}), a, b)))
        args(rest)
    case _: IO.die(Unit, 1, "expected report pairs")

def main() -> IO(Unit):
  do IO<Unit>:
    values : List<String> <- IO.args()
    args(values)

before_validation.scope: Native report classification and paired decisions for both explicitly selected precedence orders.
